name: Honda Miyu
source: The heroine of the story. Miyu is an otasa princess and is the only girl in the protagonist's group of otaku friends. Although she dislikes the protagonist's over-familiar and hyperactive attitude, she likes being treated as a princess by the circle's members. She loves anime and eroge, and gets along well with everyone. Miyu loves cute and sweet things. Her ability to illustrate is very skillful, though she is very modest about it. Because Miyu is a little timid, she hates loud places.
